solution_outline.architecture: Use semantic page regions and component-sized sections; extract only repeated visual decisions that improve consistency.
solution_outline.design_guidance: Build and document a cohesive e-commerce frontend prototype. The capstone focuses on interface engineering, not a complete payment or backend system.
implementation_steps: Implement: Responsive homepage with header, hero, categories and featured products
Implement: Product listing, badges, filtering and product detail layout
Implement: Cart and checkout interface with accessible forms and validation presentation
Implement: Customer account, order history and status displays
Implement: Light/dark themes, reusable tokens, custom utilities and component variants
Implement: Responsive testing, production build, accessibility audit and visual-regression checklist
review_notes: Start from the included Vite starter and confirm the production CSS build.
Use static complete classes for conditional utility choices.
Test keyboard states, reduced motion for animation and responsive overflow.
Document the browser and Tailwind version assumptions.

explanation: This reference outline supports human review; multiple visual implementations may satisfy the rubric.
